title.ja: 拘束・重心除去と正準統計

summary.ja: 有効自由度、運動量共分散、過渡分布と時間相関を分けて検証します。
summary.en: Separate effectiveDOF,momentum covariance,transient distributions and time correlations.

assumptions.ja: 質量1/2/3の1D3粒子と1つの共通調和ポテンシャル。拘束なし・COM・COM＋相対・冗長行を含む同じ拘束でf=3/2/1/1、各1,024レプリカを用います。
assumptions.en: Use three1Dparticles of masses1/2/3 in one common harmonic potential. No constraints,COM,COM-relative and a redundant-row equivalent have f3/2/1/1,each with1,024replicas.

algorithm.ja: 質量重み付き接空間でLangevin/CSVRをOBABO分割します。初期正準共分散からの有限時刻写像・雑音共分散を直接組み、連続参照と離散定常Lyapunov解を別に求めます。
algorithm.en: Apply tangent-space Langevin/CSVR in OBABO form. Build finite-time maps and noise covariance from canonical initial data; compute continuous references and stationary discrete Lyapunov solutions separately.

validation.ja: Fractionによる独立なrank/共分散、符号付きf1浴、正しい投影OU恒等式と誤ったambient自由度の負例を照合。220分布族、符号付き2時刻積、正しい/誤った温度分母を保存します。
validation.en: Check independent Fraction rank/covariance,signedf1 baths,the valid projectedOU identity and a wrong-ambientDOF counterexample. Retain220CDF families,signed two-time products and correct/incorrect temperature denominators.

limits.ja: 固定線形拘束の小例です。非線形分子拘束、Fixman補正、輸送係数へ一般化しません。独立seedの冗長拘束系には軌跡の一致を要求せず、CSVRの動的相関は経験的な結果です。
limits.en: These fixed linear constraints do not cover nonlinear molecular constraints,Fixman corrections or transport coefficients. Redundant systems with independent seeds need not have identical paths; CSVR dynamical correlations are empirical.

review.ja: source-reading.jsonに実際の読取範囲と未読部分を記録。原著の全式・全図の再現とは主張しません。
review.en: Actual selected read scopes and unread limits are recorded in source-reading.json; no full original-paper equation/figure reproduction claim.

scope.ja: 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。
scope.en: These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems.
